items.heading: Doro Wat
details: Key ingredients: chicken, berbere spice blend, onion, garlic, ginger, hard-boiled eggs
Slow-cook a large quantity of chopped onion until deeply softened.
Stir in berbere spice, garlic and ginger, then add chicken pieces.
Simmer until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick and deep red.
Add hard-boiled eggs to warm through before serving with injera.

items.heading: Injera
details: Key ingredients: teff flour, water
Mix teff flour with water and let the batter ferment for a couple of days.
Pour a thin layer of the sour batter onto a hot flat griddle.
Cover and cook until the surface is covered in small bubbles and set.
Cool and use as a spongy flatbread to scoop up stews.

items.heading: Shiro Wat
details: Key ingredients: chickpea flour, onion, garlic, berbere spice, oil
Saute onion, garlic and berbere spice in oil until fragrant.
Whisk in chickpea flour with water to avoid lumps.
Simmer, stirring often, until it thickens into a smooth stew.
Serve warm with injera.
